items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: I used to play with a band called the Yo-Yo Boys. No, well, I'll tell you who that was. Andrew Jefferson, Joe Goods.

ctx.x: Oh, we experienced one of the, was, we always experienced one of the, uh, advertising, uptown somewhere, I can't remember the street, you know, I can't remember what bass player it was, but we were just a plane. And so, when the band stopped playing, well, we called, so we've gone to another corner. There was a tree hanging low, a tree branch. That bass got hooked to that tree branch, there go the bass, and the bass player, he hung on to his bass. Oh, my God. Hanging on that tree, you know, had to go help him…
